leads.summary: The UK National Crime Agency announced final sentencing in a people-smuggling case, with combined jail terms of more than 84 years for the network's remaining members.
leads.title: 84 Years in Jail: Who Financed the People-Smuggling Network Behind the Channel
leads.angle: The sentences close a criminal case, but the investigation would trace who financed and organised the smuggling network, which routes and ports were used, how migrants were moved and paid for, and what happens to the people left on the French side of the Channel.
leads.centre: English Channel and the UK–France smuggling routes
leads.people: Migrants risking their lives on the Channel; the convicted organisers, drivers and boat owners; people smugglers' financiers and business partners; border and coastguard agencies; families of those who died or went missing on the route.
